LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_RiftButcher_Desc: Consumes one Rift Butcher sigil and calls a hovering Dominion-severance mini-boss after the colony has proven it can contain an army-scale horde gate. The Butcher breaks static firing lines with hook snares, short rift dashes, close severance sweeps, and small threshold reinforcements.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_RiftButcher_Rewards: • Guaranteed Severance Core from the post-horde mini-boss • Bridge reward between Horde Fragment economy and Dominion access • Melee/implant-facing material hook without skipping into full Dominion Slice
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_RiftButcher_SideEffects: • Spawns a hostile hovering melee mini-boss rather than another horde • Hook snares and dash follow-ups punish static backlines • Severance sweeps punish dense melee piles and door-block clusters
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRewardGuaranteed_RiftButcher: Guaranteed: 1 Severance Core, a heavy residue payout, and horde-fragment continuity from the post-horde mini-boss gate.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRewardProgression_RiftButcher: Progression: proves the colony can survive a surgical line-breaker before Dominion Slice access is allowed.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleFail_RiftButcherLocked: The Rift Butcher cannot be routed until the first horde gate has been contained on this save.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleFail_DominionButcherLocked: The dominion gate remains sealed until the Rift Butcher has been defeated on this save.
LanguageData.ABY_FirstHordeClearDesc: The first army-scale horde gate has collapsed under colony fire. Its closure pattern can now be compressed into a severance routing key for the Rift Butcher.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSummonSuccessDesc: The circle has pulled a Dominion-severance line-breaker into the map and clamped its escort close to the impact wound. Do not let the Butcher settle into your firing line: it will hook, dash, and cut defensive formations apart.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherKillDesc: The Rift Butcher's severance frame has collapsed. Its core proves the colony can survive a surgical Dominion prelude, and the Dominion gate may now be armed.
